# GitHub Copilot Instructions for Unitae

## Project Overview

Unitae is an open-source project licensed under the MIT License. This repository aims to provide a collaborative platform for developers.

## General Guidelines

### Code Quality

- Write clean, readable, and maintainable code
- Follow the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle
- Add meaningful comments for complex logic
- Use descriptive variable and function names

### Testing

- Write tests for new features and bug fixes
- Ensure tests are clear and test one thing at a time
- Include both positive and negative test cases
- Maintain high test coverage

### Documentation

- Update documentation when adding or modifying features
- Include README files for new modules or components
- Add inline documentation for public APIs
- Keep documentation up to date with code changes

### Version Control

- Write clear, concise commit messages
- Use semantic versioning for releases
- Keep commits focused and atomic
- Reference issue numbers in commit messages when applicable

## Code Style

- Follow language-specific best practices and idioms
- Use consistent formatting throughout the codebase
- Prefer readability over cleverness
- Use linting tools to maintain code quality

## Security

- Never commit sensitive data (API keys, passwords, tokens)
- Validate and sanitize all user inputs
- Follow security best practices for the technology stack
- Keep dependencies up to date

## Contribution Workflow

- Create feature branches from main
- Keep pull requests focused and reasonably sized
- Ensure all tests pass before requesting review
- Address review feedback promptly and thoughtfully

## Best Practices

- Think before implementing - consider edge cases and potential issues
- Prefer simple solutions over complex ones
- Consider performance implications of your changes
- Write code that is easy to debug and maintain
